body: Rick Ross urges Grand Theft Auto VI players to find his Miami mansion. GTA VI has dominated the conversation online since its release on Nov. 19, and several rappers are featured in or somehow involved in the game. Rick Ross recently posted a video on his Instagram Story imploring people playing the game to seek out his Miami Beach mansion on Star Island. “Who can pull up, Vice City, pull up to Star Island and see the muthaf**kin B. O. A. T.? ” Ross asked.
